label: 设备及其服务
definition: JSG's 分产品 revenue-table line '设备及其服务' (equipment and services), FY2025 annual report p22. Spans the issuer's whole equipment-and-service business across silicon crystal-growth/wafer-processing, SiC and sapphire compound-semiconductor equipment and photovoltaic equipment -- JSG is not a thinning-only specialist, and this basket is never allocated to thinning or any other single atlas category. Table basis is 营业收入 (total operating revenue): 分产品 (设备及其服务 + 材料 + 其他) cross-foots exactly to 营业收入合计 in both FY2025 and FY2024 with zero residual, confirming a total-operating-revenue partition.

label: 未完成集成电路及化合物半导体装备合同
definition: JSG's uncompleted (未完成) contracts for integrated-circuit and compound-semiconductor equipment at 31 December 2025, as stated in the 主营业务分析 narrative of its FY2025 annual report (physical p20), tax-inclusive. Equipment only: the sentence says 装备合同 and, unlike the 18.50 亿元 revenue figure beside it, excludes materials. Spans several atlas equipment categories (thinning, bonding, deposition, implant, cleaning and the compound-semi furnaces) and must never be allocated across them. Excludes photovoltaic equipment, which JSG reports separately and which is the larger part of its business.
notes: Created for the order-backlog row in the W13 supplement. JSG gives no prior-year comparative for this figure, so it is a single as-of stock with no series.

label: 材料
definition: JSG 分产品 row 材料 in the H1 2026 占比 10%以上 table. Substrates and consumables, not equipment.

label: 境内
definition: JSG 分地区 row 境内 in the H1 2026 占比 10%以上 table. No overseas row is printed; the residual is not assumed to be overseas.

label: 制造业
definition: JSG 分行业 row 制造业 in the H1 2026 占比 10%以上 table.

label: 集成电路与化合物半导体（含 SiC、蓝宝石等）设备及材料收入
definition: Narrative revenue basket in the H1 2026 report p21. Combines IC and compound-semiconductor equipment with materials, including SiC and sapphire substrates. Not an equipment figure; never allocate to thinning.
